simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מְלַךְ (H4431) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: מְלַךְ (mᵉlak) means advice First listed occurrence: Dan 4 24.

definitions.full: H4431. melek [ מְלֵךְ ] noun masculine counsel, advice ; — suffix מִלְכִּי Dan 4:24 let my counsel be acceptable to thee.
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to 4427 in the sense of consultation;
